results.name: Route 66 Fluorescent Hanging Light
results.description:
A 1960s style fluorescent hanging light modelled as a supporting prop for a personal Route 66 desert gas station environment project. Modelled in Autodesk Maya using high to low poly baking, UV mapped in Maya, and textured in Adobe Substance Painter using a PBR workflow.

Modelled from a non-orthographic reference image — a deliberate step forward from relying purely on blueprint references, developing confidence in reading form and proportion from real world photographic reference. Part of the same production pipeline as the hero gas pump asset — Maya modelling, high to low poly bake, Substance Painter texturing.

The light will feature in the final Route 66 gas station environment scene alongside the gas pump, station building, and surrounding desert props. Currently in active development.

Software: Autodesk Maya | Adobe Substance Painter | Unreal Engine 5
Portfolio: https://3dkendall.art/

results.name: Fluorescent Lamp/Light - 4096px²
results.description: Hey, rarely do I talk about my model creation process, but I had a lot of fun making this one. The wires and chains are fully geometry node driven, no physics simulations, just some nodes paired with bezier curves to get that natural hang. I Hope you enjoy it.
